description: One month already added up: income, expenses, balance, savings rate; how each compares with last month, the three-month average and the same month last year; the category breakdown rolled up to parents; the fixed-versus-variable split; and where the income came from. Defaults to the current month. Every figure comes from the same call the app own Insights screen makes, so they cannot disagree.
